Options A, C and D were explained by mechanisms that do not produce them (python3): drift for one year gives 37.6% (not 22.4%), a mis-signed variance term gives 1.5% (not 12.5%), and no drift gives 49.3% (not 24.8%). The analysis, the trap explanation and B's operator (scope-condition-error to wrong-input-twin) were updated. Key D unchanged: 500,000 + 183,185 = 683,185.

The option A analysis said a USD 5.00 fee would make the account lose USD 3.40 a month. Against costs of 8.00 it loses 3.00; 3.40 is the shortfall against the 8.40 target fee. Corrected. Key D unchanged (5.00 + 3.00 + 0.40 = 8.40).
